experiments.scope: Target sha256-r54-prefix-v1 with the two-block 64-byte messages of proof Section 1. GEN_C is the normative freestanding C setup source. Before every request the organizer runs packaged Python BGen and BoundedEmitter as its byte-exact mirror, checks all 15 C fields, the source hash, q, and the eef9be25bd24343490f9e9fae5d3b781370c2c0d764ee0f6fc5d4eb82d163229 SLP hash. The native/wasm counts are participant-run accounting. Each trial runs one complete width-16 attempt with the shipped search, table, cut rule, recovery, inverse, feed-forward, and fixed second block.
experiments.hypothesis: Every returned pair contains distinct messages whose complete 54-step digests agree in the low 16 bits. Null returns are valid. Counts are program checks, not probability estimates.

experiments.scope: Target sha256-r54-prefix-v1 with the two-block 64-byte messages of proof Section 1. GEN_C is the normative freestanding C setup source. Before every request the organizer runs packaged Python BGen and BoundedEmitter as its byte-exact mirror, checks all 15 C fields, the source hash, q, and the eef9be25bd24343490f9e9fae5d3b781370c2c0d764ee0f6fc5d4eb82d163229 SLP hash. The native/wasm counts are participant-run accounting. All 64 observed groups iterate one fixed 20-bit function h selected from all organizer request seeds: one coordinate injection into the actual walk g=f XOR q and one coordinate projection back. Per-group visited sets preserve shared inputs and merged tails. DP hits count only globally fresh inputs. The null has 64 complete ensembles, each with one shared lazy mapping across its 64 groups. The first 16 seeds also run the actual table, cut, restart, probe, insertion, and recovery logic on the same h.
experiments.hypothesis: At width 20 and a 1200-step censoring point, the observed four-bin first-collision score is no larger than 1.25 times the maximum score of 32 validation null ensembles after 32 separate null ensembles estimate bin means and variances. The observed global-fresh-input DP z-score is within the larger of 4 and 1.25 times the maximum absolute validation-null z-score. The source commits the test before an organizer holdout nonce. Passing supports reduced-width consistency only; it does not prove H1 or extrapolate to width 256.
